raw_market.description:
In the first half of the college football game between Minnesota and Purdue, scheduled for October 10 at 8:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if Minnesota score 12 or more points in the first half.

If Minnesota score less than 12 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on Minnesota's score, not the combined score of both teams.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
